contexts.text: Branches () = scientifics. AC 2588:15.
Root and branch () = charity and truth.
To give the branch among the thicket () = to reason from scientifics.
While his branch is yet tender, etc. () = the first of a new Church... The fig tree = the good of the natural; the branch = its affection.

The spiritual Church is here compared to a vine (), and its derivations are described even to the ultimates in the natural man, namely, to scientifics from sensuous things, which are the entwined branches. AE 727:3.
Regeneration is signified by giving a branch and bearing fruit ().
Scientific truth is signified by the branch of a thick tree (). AC 8369. AC 9296:6. AE 458:4.
Under Root, see this reference.
Trees = perceptions and Knowledges of good and truth; hence branches = truths themselves.
The tree is man... the stem or stalk with the branches and leaves are the means, and are called the truths of faith.
The life's love is that tree, the branches with leaves are the affections of good and truth with their perceptions.
With twigs taken from the tree of life.
Branches = man's sensuous and natural truths.
A gate constructed of branches...
The branches... are as man's members...
Branches = truths thence derived. AE 532:7.
To make a branch () = to multiply truths.
Branches () = extension.
Branch () = truth of faith.
Rod of branches () = falsity of doctrine in which there is evil.
Branch () = spiritual truth.
The third state is signified by his branches shall go forth (), by which is signified the multiplication of scientific truth and Knowledges.
Under Beauty, see this reference.
They made her beautiful through the multitude of branches () = abundance of scientific truths rationally perceived.
All scientific and rational truths dissipated through evils and falsities is signified by upon the mountains and in the valleys his branches are fallen ().
